extensionDescription.message: Switch between Firefox profiles with one click. The current profile closes and keeps all its tabs. Requires a small helper app for Windows.

helperMissing.message: Quick Profile Switch: helper app not found. Click to set it up.

mergeFailed.message: Not all tabs could be merged, so the profile stays open.

menuCloseOnSwitch.message: Close this profile when switching (tabs are kept)

popupNoHelper.message: The helper app is not reachable.

setupIntro.message: Firefox does not allow add-ons to start other profiles on their own. A small helper app does this for Quick Profile Switch. It runs only on this computer and sends no data anywhere.

setupStep1.message: Download the helper app for Windows:

setupStep2.message: Double-click the downloaded file. It installs itself for your Windows user, without admin rights. Windows may warn you because the file is not signed by a company: choose “More info” and then “Run anyway”.

setupStep3.message: Come back here and check the setup:

setupOk.message: Everything is set up. Click the toolbar button or press Alt+Shift+P to switch profiles.

setupMissing.message: The helper app was not found yet. Did the installation finish?

setupNotes.message: Only Windows is supported at the moment. To remove the helper app later, use Windows Settings → Apps → Installed apps → Quick Profile Switch.
